_meta.units: camera-RGB normalised to THIS panel's own black=0/white=255 - NOT sRGB; directions only, never magnitudes

defect_9_v_lo_v_hi_inert.what: target_huevalue honours --v-lo/--v-hi only on the isolate branch; the default joint branch hard-codes 40..245
defect_9_v_lo_v_hi_inert.proof: target_huevalue(v_lo=20,v_hi=100) vs (40,245) on the joint path: identical, max pixel diff 0; on the isolate path max pixel diff 255
defect_9_v_lo_v_hi_inert.consequence: the four huevalue_lowv_* rows are NOT a low-value block - they re-shoot the same v=40..245 grid; the shipped value_in labels are CORRECT and A1's relabelling to 20/36/52/68/84/100 must be discarded; the dark end of the hue x value table was never measured
defect_9_v_lo_v_hi_inert.fix: one line in target_huevalue, or always pass --isolate for the low-value re-shoot

defect_10_inkmix_cell_search_exceeds_cel.what: grid_offsets searches +-30 px per cell; content_box narrowing made inkmix cells 67x86 (docstring still says 101x98), so the search reaches the neighbouring cell and minimum-interior-variance selects it
defect_10_inkmix_cell_search_exceeds_cel.proof: shipped readout has blue+green = [254,253,252] at all five ratios - two dark inks in a checkerboard cannot make paper white
defect_10_inkmix_cell_search_exceeds_cel.consequence: inkmix mixtures, element_sweep and metamer_row are misregistered for 4-7 of 15 columns under every arm tried; the optical mixing law is not measurable from this corpus
defect_10_inkmix_cell_search_exceeds_cel.fix: clamp the per-cell search to a fraction of the cell margin, and re-shoot inkmix at a coarser grid

error_bars_addendum._basis: 4 pairs of BIT-IDENTICAL huevalue renders captured 2.3 h apart with independent alignment solutions (main block vs the mislabelled lowv reshoot). A1's huevalue bars come from replicates that share one alignment.

cells_chroma_out_single_cross_condition.note: A1's 15 applies WITHIN one alignment family only

n_collapsed_total.note: A1's 9 is the more conservative; used throughout

adr_091.verdict: ACCEPTED on mechanism; its TABLE is wrong by ~7.6x; 'not hue-limited' does NOT survive

table_reproduced_in_output_palette.note: exact match => ADR-091 measured the OUTPUT palette (pure primaries), i.e. the client encoding, not the ink

table_in_dither_palette.consequence: ADR-091's '250-460% over-saturation at v=100' is an encoding artefact; in ink terms the panel UNDER-saturates there. Its follow-on chroma-attenuation hypothesis must not be actioned as written.

on_glass_wp0_baseline.verdict: 'every hue survives at v=100' CONFIRMED; 'six collapse by v=220' directionally confirmed but overstated (1 at v=204, 4 at v=245)

superposition_test.verdict: white-point acts on chroma PURELY through value - ADR-091's mechanism, confirmed by a test that could have failed

hue_dependence.correction: the luminance limit is HUE-DEPENDENT; hues 150 and 330 are weak at EVERY value (peak 40 and 43 vs 182 at hue 0) and are gamut holes no luminance operator fills

vs_palette.warning: camera over-saturates by construction - directions only; NEVER rewrite SPECTRA6_DITHER_PALETTE from this. A colorimeter or an in-frame ColorChecker is required.

wp_x_chroma_interaction.design: complete 2^4 factorial in block 2 (rows 48-112, randomisation verified by A1): wp{0.64,0.88} x gamma{1.0,1.8} x k{1.0,2.0} x sat{0.7,1.3}, 16/16 corners
wp_x_chroma_interaction.verdict: REAL, ~3x: the chroma lever costs 43.7/255 at wp 0.88 and 14.9 at wp 0.64. The two white-points are indistinguishable with the chroma lever OFF.

block1_for_continuity_only.note: wp aliased with capture time (A1 r=+0.883)

wp_x_chroma_interaction.adr_088: supports the brief's diagnosis: at wp off the top of the range holds 49.2 chroma with the lever off and 3.7 with k=2.0 (8/12 hues collapsed) - the lever was judged where the colour had already gone

dither_bleed_joint_vs_isolate.verdict: FS cross-cell bleed costs 6.0/255 of grid-mean chroma on huevalue; it is in the RENDER not the instrument, and is predictable offline. Bounds A1's open surround term for this target only.

simulator_validation.what: render each condition through the exact _pre chain, map the output-palette result onto THIS panel's measured inks, compose, run the same readout_huevalue
simulator_validation.verdict: the simulator predicts the panel as well as the panel predicts itself; per-cell disagreement is registration, not model error

chroma_survival._what: measured output chroma as a function of what the quantiser was ASKED for: C_out ~= S(L_in) * C_in
chroma_survival._units: L_in, C_in = mean and (max-min) of the pre-quantise RGB, 0-255; C_out panel-relative
chroma_survival._domain: C_in >= 25; fitted on 3528 cells from 50 huevalue conditions
chroma_survival.by_hue_note: hues 150 and 300 fit a near-flat curve (w=36 and 59); their L50 is poorly determined
chroma_survival.coverage_warning: the pale-AND-chromatic corner (L_in>140 with C_in<30) is EMPTY - exactly Olympia's regime. Figures there come from the validated simulator, i.e. extrapolation.

flat_patch_ceiling_C_in_27.5.note: 7.2 = the white ink's own chroma, i.e. the patch is 100% white ink and DEAD
flat_patch_ceiling_C_in_27.5.source: validated measured-ink simulator, not a photograph

tone_curve_chroma_budget.rule: a curve L -> 255*(L/255)^gamma pushes a pixel over the 163 ink ceiling when L > 255*(163/255)**(1/gamma); everything with colour between that line and 163 loses it

population_check.note: toy population C_in=27.5, hues 0/30/300, L_in uniform 110-210, on the measured-ink simulator

tone_curve_chroma_budget.reconciliation: ADR-090's ink ceiling (163) and this corpus's chroma half-life (152) are the same number from independent targets. ADR-091 read as a permission (compression buys gamut) is the same statement as: every luminance LIFT spends colour, at a rate computable from the work's histogram.

limits: corpus has no gamma < 1 - lifting was never photographed; the survival function covers the luminances a lift reaches but the equivalence relies on the v_eff superposition, which is verified for white-point and untested for gamma<1
L_in > 220 unreached; L_in > 140 with C_in < 30 unreached
the dark end (L_in < 50) is confounded with the rig's ~24/255 black-end lift

inkmix_provisional.status: NOT MEASURABLE from this corpus - two law-free registration criteria disagree; see defect 10
inkmix_provisional.mixing_space: optimum gamma ~0.9-1.0: panel-relative camera RGB is already a mixing-linear space for this rig, because the readout averages ENCODED pixels over a window and the affine is applied to encoded values. A 2.2 decode ADDS error.

dot_gain_effective_coverage.verdict: coverage within +-0.06 of nominal; the shipped 'far darker than linear' reading is a registration artefact, not dot gain

element_size_sweep.verdict: a 16x change in element pitch moves a chromatic mixture 5.0/255, while the strip-vs-field disagreement is 42-78/255. Element size does NOT explain the patch-size effect; that is patch size and surround (lateral scatter).

inkmix_provisional.metamer: UNANSWERED - only one designed pair falls within 20/255 under the additive model, and the instrument is not trusted. Needs a re-shoot at a coarser cell pitch.
